user.title: Configure MaDo
user.description: Enter the URL of your self-hosted MaDo API server.

data_description.api_token: Required when the MaDo server has API authentication enabled.
data_description.user_id: The name of the memory MaDo keeps for your household. Leave it as 'default'. You can change it later, and choose whether everyone shares one memory, under Configure.

hassio_confirm.title: MaDo Detected
hassio_confirm.description: The MaDo add-on has been detected. Would you like to set it up?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the MaDo API. Make sure it's running and accessible.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API token. Check your token on the MaDo dashboard.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the MaDo add-on. Make sure it's running.

init.title: MaDo
init.description: Choose whether everyone in your home shares one memory with MaDo, and whether voice requests can be shown on a wall tablet.

data_description.shared_memory: On (recommended): everyone shares one memory, so something you tell a voice satellite is also known in the app and on the dashboard, and the other way round. Off: each Home Assistant user gets a memory of their own, and voice satellites and automations use the memory named below.
data_description.user_id: The memory MaDo uses for the whole household, or, with shared memory off, for voice satellites and automations. Leave it as 'default' unless you have a reason to change it.
data_description.voice_display: On: the 'MaDo Assist' sensor follows each voice-satellite request (question, answer, actions), and devices you switch on show it full screen, by opening Home Assistant once with ?mado_tablet=1 at the end of the address. The texts are not kept in the history. Off: no sensor, nothing is shown.

confirm.title: Restart required
confirm.description: Home Assistant needs a restart to finish updating MaDo ({running_version} → {installed_version}). Click Submit to restart Home Assistant now — or close this and restart later, at a moment that suits you. MaDo keeps working in the meantime.
